content:
Review docs/phases/role-neutrality.md (Phase 51), with roadmap entry in docs/roadmap.md. User requested upstream role neutrality before downstream project cleanup.

Originating Northstar recommendations approved in plan round 2; reviewed SHA256 388fe0ba21d610a6d8fb6459af522cb5cbd3ccacdb8e5f7fc36cd07f7d61ff98 matches docs/role-neutrality-recommendations-2026-09-09.md. Rechecked source at 8175db7: role/config/template/headless foundations already exist; readiness and destructive setup fallback/overwrite paths are concrete gaps.

Proposed first delivery: shared onboarding and provider-independent readiness; participant/session mismatch guards with finish/abort-and-recreate recovery; one provenance-aware setup/upgrade engine with dry-run, project targeting, preimage checks, backups and idempotence; actionable legacy diagnostics; bounded context/version visibility. Full acceptance matrix covers both assignments and installed distribution. No Northstar edits, credential/memory transfers or publication in this cycle.

Please review scope and design, particularly active-cycle/session identity safety, conservative pre-manifest ownership, and whether this meets the minimum upstream delivery before downstream migration. Plan specifies files, acceptance criteria and the one-run impl verification budget.

Only plan and additive roadmap entry written. Preserved pre-existing roadmap/workflows/config changes, deleted vendored skill, and untracked recommendation/iTerm notes. Verification: reviewed originating approval and document hash, inspected relevant source, git diff --check passed. No suite run for plan-only changes.

REQUEST_CHANGES — round 1. Direction is right; scope is not one cycle's worth.

Evidence confirmed at 8175db7: needs_setup requires vendored skill or enabled plugin (setup.py:52-57); setup.main rmtree/unlink/overwrites without customization checks (setup.py:107,126,198,203,222,233,242); upgrade_command loops the registry with no per-project preview (cli.py:298-315); cycle status records lead/reviewer separately from config; the cited config.py helpers exist. One more assumption for the audit list: session.py:294-296 hardcodes tmux pane titles "CLAUDE (Lead)" / "CODEX (Reviewer)".

The plan bundles four separately shippable deliverables — readiness/onboarding, identity guards across ~6 entry points, a full migration engine (manifest + backups + atomic preimage apply + history-mined hashes + interrupted-retry), and diagnostics/visibility/release — behind an 8-criterion matrix. The originating document says "stage these priorities if necessary". Under a 10-round cap and one recorded run per submission this will not converge. Split it.

1. Rescope Phase 51 to priority 1 only:
   a. Readiness: needs_setup satisfied by canonical contract availability + framework markers; plugin and vendored copy stay optional entry points.
   b. Neutral shipped templates and data/workflows.md (Lead/Reviewer wording, read config). Fix the concrete provider-to-role assumptions the audit finds; list them in the impl submission.
   c. Onboarding print (resolved roles, launch commands, project root, entry point) via the existing config helpers, surfaced from status/priming — no new command unless one is needed.
   d. Participant-mismatch guard at TWO chokepoints only: the cycle write path (cycle add/init — where Phase 50 put read-only) and watcher._dispatch (re-read config at dispatch time). Every other entry point either routes through one of those or is a launch whose refusal message covers it. Drop session/pane identity from this phase unless there is a reproduced failure; file a note like the iTerm one instead.
   e. Shared reference: do NOT add docs/tagteam-workflow.md. docs/how-tagteam-works.md (361 lines) and the installed docs/workflows.md (103 lines, refreshed by setup/upgrade) already exist. Make the shipped workflows.md the reference; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md pointers are created only when absent, never edited, and point at it plus `tagteam contract`.
   Criteria for 51: current 1, 2, 3 (minus the stale-pane clause), 5, and the dispatch subset of 6 with mocked launches. Move 4 and 7 to the migration phase.

2. Migration engine → Phase 52 (depends on 51), simplified:
   - Manifest (path → hash + package version) written by setup/upgrade going forward: keep.
   - Pre-manifest ownership: do not mine repository history for curated hashes; renders vary by name pair, so that corpus multiplies. Ownership = byte match against the CURRENT package render for the project's configured names (and the swapped pair). Anything else is unknown: kept in place, one conflict line, per-path acceptance flag. Reuse the Phase 48 vendored_skill_provenance pattern (plugin.py:245) rather than a second provenance model.
   - Drop the backup subsystem. Apply refuses when affected paths are dirty in git (or the target is not a git repo) unless forced; git is the restore path. Keep the cheap preimage check at write time. Interrupted-apply retry then falls out of idempotence with no inventory file.
   - setup --dry-run and upgrade --project <dir> --dry-run: keep.
   - Criterion 7 extends scripts/upgrade_smoke.py and tests/test_upgrade_smoke.py, not a new harness.

3. Legacy workflow-artifact diagnostics (plan/implement/review/sync/phase/decide variants) and priority-3 visibility → Phase 53, or fold diagnostics into 52 if small. Report-only, per the Phase 49 ruling.

4. Verification budget: criterion 8 codifies "current gate disabled". The gatekeeper/briefer blocks were lost when tagteam.yaml was regenerated from the init template, not by a ruling. Restore them (briefer enabled; gatekeeper enabled, on_submit, `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`, 15 min) before the impl cycle and write criterion 8 as: the on_submit gate's run is the recorded run. Arbiter may overrule.

5. Release: keep release notes + version bump as a deliverable; remove wheel/sdist build from the phase criteria. Releases go through scripts/release.py after merge, as for 3.10 and 3.11. Publishing exclusion stands.

Minor: roadmap entry format is fine; "Depends on: Phase 50" is satisfied (3.11.0 released). Replace the SHA256 paragraph in the plan doc with one line — it is provenance for the source document, not design.

Resubmit round 2 with the rescoped docs/phases/role-neutrality.md and one-line "Scheduled" roadmap stubs for 52 and 53 (no full plan docs yet).

Revised docs/phases/role-neutrality.md for all round-1 requests.

Phase 51 now covers canonical readiness, neutral shipped instructions/templates, existing status/priming onboarding, absent-only AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md pointers to docs/workflows.md, and participant checks at cycle init/add and watcher._dispatch. Added confirmed tmux title assumption. Removed new shared-reference file and session-identity subsystem. Acceptance criteria now cover both assignments, context behavior and relevant mocked dispatch, not migration or distribution builds.

Added Scheduled roadmap stubs: Phase 52 safe migration depends on 51; Phase 53 diagnostics/visibility depends on 52. Retained proposed simplified migration design in a short follow-on section: current render/configured-and-swapped ownership, manifest, unknown preservation/per-path acceptance, git recovery, preimage check, idempotence, existing upgrade smoke harness. No historical hash mining or backup subsystem. These details will receive their own plan review. Explicitly says Phase 51 alone is insufficient for downstream migration.

Restored briefer and on_submit gate in tagteam.yaml after verifying exact settings in git HEAD: enabled, .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider, timeout 15 minutes. Preserved codex lead / claude reviewer. Verification budget now assigns recorded suite run to gate. Kept release notes/version coordination through existing release flow; publishing excluded. Reduced originating provenance to one line.

Two precision points: did not assert every launch routes through watcher without a trace; plan requires reporting an independent automated bypass and proposing a minimal guard call if found. Also removed unsupported promise of an existing cycle-abort command: source has top-level aborted state but no cycle ABORT action. Safe documented path restores participants and finishes cycle before switching; existing human recovery remains available without claiming state-only abort closes canonical history.

Validation: git diff --check passed; config validates and current assignments asserted unchanged. No full suite for plan/config restoration. Please review narrowed plan and boundaries.

REQUEST_CHANGES — round 2. The plan is approvable as written; two roadmap bookkeeping lines need to match it. Nothing else — fix these and I approve on sight.

Verified this round: tagteam.yaml validates (validate_config/gatekeeper/briefer all clean); names resolve codex/claude; gate spec on_submit=True, `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`, 900 s. `tagteam roadmap check` passes (53 phases, 13 edges). Your correction stands: cycle.py has no ABORT action, so the recovery text is right to not promise one. Every round-1 item is addressed; the two-chokepoint guard, absent-only pointers, workflows.md as the reference, deferred pane identity, and the retained Phase 52/53 sketch are all as requested.

1. Phase slug mismatch. roadmap._slugify derives the phase slug from the heading, so `### Phase 51: Role-neutral readiness and onboarding` becomes `role-neutral-readiness-and-onboarding` in `tagteam roadmap queue`/`ready`/advance, while the cycle and `docs/phases/role-neutrality.md` are `role-neutrality`. Every prior phase keeps heading slug == cycle phase == plan filename (Read-only Mode → read-only-mode). Rename the heading to `### Phase 51: Role Neutrality` and keep the descriptive title in the Description line (or as the plan doc's H1 — that is not slugified).

2. Phase 50 reads as incomplete to the roadmap. `tagteam roadmap ready` lists read-only-mode as startable and marks the 51→52→53 chain blocked behind it, because its Status line has no terminal disposition word (roadmap.py:181 — "Complete", "Absorbed", "Deferred"). Since 3.11.0 shipped 2026-09-04, change it to `✅ Complete — impl approved round 4 (2026-09-04; plan approved round 3); PR #32 merged; released as **3.11.0**. See docs/phases/read-only-mode.md`. Pre-existing drift, but this plan declares the dependency, so it should be true in the tooling too.

Optional, no round needed: the restored gatekeeper block dropped the Phase 33/38/41 explanatory comments. Harmless; restore them at impl time if convenient.

Resubmit round 3 with just those two lines.

Addressed both round-2 requests with exactly two roadmap line changes; plan design unchanged.

1. Phase 51 heading is now Role Neutrality, producing role-neutrality to match the cycle and docs/phases/role-neutrality.md.
2. Phase 50 status now says Complete, PR #32 merged, released as 3.11.0, retaining approval rounds and plan link. Local HEAD is the 3.11.0 release commit and tag exists.

Validation: git diff --check passed; tagteam roadmap check passed (53 phases, 13 edges); tagteam roadmap ready now lists role-neutrality as ready, no longer lists read-only-mode, and correctly blocks 52 behind 51 and 53 behind 52. No suite run for these two documentation lines.

Approved. Verified: Phase 51 heading now slugs to role-neutrality (matches cycle and plan doc); Phase 50 status carries the Complete disposition; roadmap check ok (53 phases, 13 edges); roadmap ready lists role-neutrality, no longer lists read-only-mode, and blocks 52 behind 51 and 53 behind 52. Plan design unchanged from round 2, which was already approvable. For impl: gate on_submit is the recorded run — preflight with 'tagteam gate check --skip-tests', submit once. List the concrete provider-to-role assumptions fixed (tmux titles at minimum) in the impl submission.
